hero.lead: One clinical vocabulary for the whole hospital. Patients, diseases, symptoms, treatments and appointments are described as individuals of a Web Ontology Language model, then queried live.
hero.pointRecords: Every record is a described individual, never a detached row.
hero.pointKnowledge: Browse by disease category, symptom, specialty or department.
hero.pointAccess: Four roles, one permission matrix, every write audited.
hero.footnote: Your data stays in your own triple store.

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: Use the credentials issued by your administrator.
login.alertHint: Check the address and the password, then try again.

demo.heading: Demo accounts
demo.hint: Quick fill only puts the seeded demo email in the field; the password is the demo one documented in the README.

register.title: Create an account
register.subtitle: Registration creates your medical record individual and your login in one step.
register.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, including a letter and a digit.
register.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
register.conflictHint: Use another address, or sign in with the existing account.
register.successText: Your login and your medical record individual have been created. Sign in to open the patient portal.
register.patientRoleNotice: Your account will be created as a patient. Administrators assign staff roles.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Record the request so your administrator can issue a new password.
forgot.sentText: Mail delivery is out of scope in this project: the request is only recorded by the API, and the answer is identical whether or not the address belongs to an account.
